description: Book an appointment slot with a service provider.

user_id.description: ID of the user booking the appointment

service_id.description: ID of the service being booked

start_time.description: ISO8601 datetime for the appointment start

duration_minutes.description: Duration of the appointment in minutes; must be positive

reminder_minutes.description: Optional minutes before appointment to send a reminder; must be positive

payment.description: Optional payment details for the appointment

method.description: Payment method: card, wallet, or insurance

card_last4.description: Last 4 digits of the card used; applicable when method is card

insurance_id.description: Insurance policy identifier; applicable when method is insurance

intake_form.description: Optional pre-appointment intake form submitted by the patient

last_visit.description: Optional ISO 8601 date of the patient's last visit

send_confirmation.description: Whether to send a booking confirmation to the user; defaults to true

confirmation_channels.description: Optional list of channels on which to send the confirmation: email, sms, or push
